rca of the issue: React Router v6 resolves `Navigate to='..'` **relative to the Route's path pattern in the routes tree**, not by trimming URL segments. For a flat top-level route like `/session/:sessionId/interview/start`, the parent route in the tree is the app root (`/`), so `..` climbs all the way to `/` before appending `simulation/start`, producing `/simulation/start`. Since no route matches that path, the SPA fallback lands on the 404 page. Reproduction: log in as testagent2026, hit `<REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL>/session/6ab63b64-2842-4f92-ad55-c33059b5ab4c/interview/start`, observe final URL `/simulation/start` and 404 UI. Mitigation: use a wrapper component that reads `useParams().sessionId` and Navigates to the absolute path `/session/${sessionId}/simulation/start`.
